method.local_cache: disabled for every request with --no-cache; not mixed cold/cache latency
method.provider_order: sequential; not randomized; provider/order/network effects remain
method.token_scope: serialized request shape plus raw or normalized JSON response
method.native_tokens: actual provider request object once plus native snippets/highlights; different content budgets
method.equal_budget_tokens: common {query,limit} request once plus normalized results with each snippet truncated to the same maximum
method.equal_budget_caveat: Equal maximum length does not equalize relevance, source ranking, or actual content length.

pricing_note: Historical estimates, not verified current prices or an actual invoice. Failed requests may incur charges.
